title: Thenkasipattanam
desc: A man, who harbours feelings for his childhood friend, hides the truth from his best friend. However, trouble arises when his best friend falls in love with her.

title: Thalaivaa
desc: Vishwa runs a small business in Sydney, unaware that his father is a gangster in Mumbai. When his father is killed by a rival, Vishwa takes over his crime syndicate with revenge on his mind.

title: Gajakesari
desc: Krishna protects the tribal people of the Aanegudde forest from Rana, a local thug, who plans to throw them out of their houses to build a resort there.

title: Water Monster
desc: A man and the villagers must fight against the water monster who returns and wreaks havoc in the village.

title: Spy
desc: An agent investigates the death of his elder brother with the help of his fellow agents. However, his actions lead to the discovery of a nuclear plot against India.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Hidimbha
desc: In Hyderabad, a series of murders targets young girls. Later, officers Aadhya and Abhay investigate as more victims disappear, soon discovering a common link among them.
